learning_outcomes.text: Use vectors and matrices in the solution of engineering problems.
Apply techniques of integration or differentiation in the solution of engineering problems.
Solve first order ordinary differential equations by the method of separation of variables and apply to the modelling of engineering problems.
Use and apply mathematical software to the solution of engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of the use of a computer algebra system (for example MATLAB or similar). Use of the software applied to the syllabus items below.
Basic vector algebra including Cartesian components and products.
Basic matrix manipulation including the inverse matrix.
Solution of systems of linear equations.
Differential calculus of one variable: Gradient of curve, derivatives of standard functions, linearity, derivatives of composite functions, products and quotients.
Integral calculus as inverse of differentiation and as a limit of a sum.
Standard integrals, linearity, integration of composite functions, numerical integration.
First order linear, constant coefficient equations.
assessment_rules: Students will complete regular online tests to monitor their engagement and progress.
